text: This book attributes the 45° relationship between the + and × polarizations (patterns that rotate by twice the rotation angle) to the graviton being:
explanation: The book states the polarization patterns transform with phase e^(±2iψ) (helicity ±2) under rotation about the propagation direction — the signature of a spin-2 field — and calls the graviton a massless spin-2 boson. A spin-1 field (the photon) transforms with e^(±iψ), giving polarizations 90° apart. The doubling of the rotation angle is precisely the spin-2 hallmark.
